concept_preparation.includes: Prompting, original hero, two turnaround variants, inspection, correction, calibration and canonical consistency document.
concept_preparation.mode: built-in image_gen; original text and generated images only

tooling_changes.experiment_specific: Separate recipe builders; concept run adds nine-point, then25-point original armor shell cages using existing mesh/solidify functions. A new read-only cache-scene submission adapter calls unchanged native renderer APIs; it adds no rendering features.
tooling_changes.fairness_limit: The concept run had one more successful iteration, an extra failed attempt and more scripting/refinement time. Any quality advantage cannot be attributed to images alone.
